runs.name: slot-pane-design
runs.description: Judge-panel design: move slot info off the chart screen into the pane system

phases.title: Propose
phases.detail: 3 designers, distinct angles, full proposals

phases.title: Judge
phases.detail: 3 judges with distinct lenses score every proposal

phases.title: Synthesize
phases.detail: lead designer merges into one spec + work packages

runs.name: slot-workspace-build
runs.description: Build the approved slot-workspace design in the isolated worktree, then integrate and smoke-test it

phases.title: Build
phases.detail: 10 work packages, each starting as soon as its dependencies finish

phases.title: Integrate
phases.detail: full lint/tests/build/backend suite, fix seams, screenshot every fixture

runs.name: slot-workspace-review
runs.description: Adversarial review of the slot-workspace build: 8 specialist reviewers, triage, per-cluster verify and fix, integration, design critique and polish

phases.title: Find
phases.detail: 8 specialist reviewers: visual, interaction, flows, React, layout model, spec/a11y, backend, copy

phases.title: Triage
phases.detail: merge duplicates, decide fix/defer/drop, cluster by file ownership

phases.title: Verify
phases.detail: one adversarial verifier per cluster

phases.title: Fix
phases.detail: one fixer per cluster, disjoint files

phases.title: Integrate
phases.detail: cross-cluster requests, every gate, reseed, final screenshots

phases.title: Critique
phases.detail: fresh-eyes principal designer review

phases.title: Polish
phases.detail: fix the critique, then re-check

runs.name: channel-page-design
runs.description: Audit the channel page, get three independent redesign proposals, and have a lead designer synthesize one buildable spec with work packages

phases.title: Audit
phases.detail: product, data and states; visual critique with screenshots

phases.title: Propose
phases.detail: three designers, three angles

phases.title: Synthesize
phases.detail: lead designer scores, merges, writes spec and work packages

phases.title: Review spec
phases.detail: three critics: product rules and mock vs real, buildability, design quality

phases.title: Revise
phases.detail: the lead verifies the findings and fixes the spec

runs.name: agentviz-build
runs.description: Build agentviz: a local web app that visualizes Claude Code agents and workflows live (backend + frontend, integrate, review, fix)

phases.title: Build
phases.detail: backend and frontend in parallel against one API contract

phases.title: Integrate
phases.detail: run it on live data, check numbers against the CLI, screenshots, fix

phases.title: Review
phases.detail: data and robustness; visual quality and usability

phases.title: Fix
phases.detail: verify the findings, fix, re-check
